## Hello, I'm Daria!
I'm a Project Manager with 3+ years of experience in the biotechnology space. I am passionate about the intersection of data and biology, and believe that great tools drive efficient research loop — from state-of-the-art pipettes to cutting-edge computational models. Soon to hold a **Master’s in Data Science**, I’m dedicated to equipping the biotech space with the tools it needs to push boundaries.

Outside of work, I enjoy reading, writing about books, playing volleyball, and exploring new cafes and restaurants.
